name: Symbolon — the twelvefold spine
description: The eight determination roots in spine order (−/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0), the four heads as traversal scenes (Mono/Poly, #, Self-Identity, Subject-Logics), and the spine-index mandala. Bound to submission-package/essay/symbolon @ dbf3b17; claim bands per record (mono-poly: Argued; all others Derived).

scenes.name: The Slash — / = −/−
scenes.character: Two dashes, one stroke: relation before named terms.

text.title: The Slash
text.body:
A dash appears twice, with a stroke between its placements: `−/−`. Neither mark has a value or name; the stroke already makes two placements readable together — relation before named terms. Arithmetic reads division and ratio; QL reads AND/OR. `(-1)/(+1)` holds direction; addition cancels; subtraction appropriates. Read upon itself, `(0/1)/(1/0)` yields `2 + 2² = 4 + 2 = 6`.
Returns-to: Movement 19, and Symbolon.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/the-slash.md

scenes.name: 0/1 — The First Orientation
scenes.character: Ground and mark in their first orientation: One through All.

text.italic: the first orientation — the singular One through the polyvalent All
text.body:
`0/1` holds the conscious circumstance in its first orientation: the singular One becomes articulate through the polyvalent All. `0` names unobjectifiable awareness; `1` the field of determinate differences. Each depends on the other in an order that cannot be exchanged. `00`, `01`, `10`, `11` — `2 + 2² = 6`. The seam stays exact: `0/1` evaluates, `1/0` undefined.
Returns-to: The Loan Returns (§1 · #5→0).
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/0-1.md

scenes.name: ?/! — Question and Assertion
scenes.character: Inquiry and naming in one sign; the four corners and their SILENCE.

text.italic: inquiry and naming in one sign
text.body:
`?` names openness to determination; `!` the act of asserting enough for a determination to stand; the slash holds them in one operation. The Catuṣkoṭi crossing tests the proposition 0 is and/or is not equal to 1: IS, IS-NOT, BOTH, NEITHER. SILENCE names the recognition through which the corners become one lived movement; the sign reappears at processual #3.
Returns-to: A18 and §3 · #0.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/question-assertion.md

scenes.name: −/+ — Negation and Affirmation
scenes.character: Withdrawal and extension, reserve and issue; the field breathes.

text.italic: withdrawal and extension, reserve and issue
text.body:
Negation's self-relation makes affirmation available: the appearing face belongs to the reserve that issues it. “The void voids itself” — determination arises through the unmarked's self-limitation. Breathing gives the relation its bodily performance: gathering and release differ, and their difference sustains one living movement. Signed, the polarity keeps its axis, `(-1)/(+1)`; addition cancels; subtraction appropriates. Within the sixfold this is #2, Dynamis.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/minus-plus.md

scenes.name: X/x — Determining Capacity and Its Particular
scenes.character: One letter in two cases; the instance multiplies.

text.title: X/x
text.body:
X names determining capacity; x its indefinite particular. The same letter carries both; the slash is the activity of determination between them. The small x also carries multiplication: an instance can recur, compound, generate further instances. The spine fixes X/x at #3, Pattern. In the psyche register the spine reads X = x — an Argued functional crosswalk, no inference to phenomenality.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/X-x.md

scenes.name: AM/IS — The Personed Copula
scenes.character: First-person presence and third-person sayability; the slash is the second person.

text.title: AM/IS
text.italic: the personed copula — the slash as second person
text.body:
AM speaks first-person presence; IS makes something available for third-person predication. The slash carries the second person: an address can be answered and alter the account's terms. The knower–means–known coordination makes the offices precise: pramātṛ, pramāṇa, prameya. The 1–2–3 pass is followed by the 4–5–0 recognition pass — read as 3:3 and 3:1. The determination occupies #4, Context.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/AM-IS.md

scenes.name: ∞/dx — Horizon and Differential
scenes.character: The horizon no finite mark contains; the differential through which relation becomes exact.

text.title: ∞/dx
text.italic: the horizon no finite mark contains
text.body:
∞ names the unbounded depth no finite mark contains; dx the local differential through which change becomes exact. The calculus makes the limit exact: `F(x)=x²+7` differentiates to `F'(x)=2x`; integrating restores a family, `∫2x dx = x²+C` — the local change does not select the original `7`. At #5, Realisation, the mark faces what it cannot possess; the same law returns as the retained `9/8`.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/infinity-dx.md

scenes.name: 1/0 — The Determination Returns
scenes.character: The same relation from its other end: the mark returns toward its condition.

text.italic: the obverse orientation — determination returns through its ground
text.body:
The parent `/ = −/−` precedes the six determinations; `1/0` turns achieved articulation back toward its condition, bracketing the sixfold without a seventh interior position. QL writes `0/1 = 1/0` — one relation read from its two ends; the arithmetic seam belongs to the notation. This is the consequent essence, `5→0`, with 5 implicated in 1 through exactly this connection.
Returns-to: A36, Advent of Integral Zero.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/1-0.md

scenes.name: Mono/Poly — One through the Many
scenes.character: The One at centre; the many held around it — mutually implicate accountings, not rival totals.

text.title: Mono/Poly
text.italic: one through the many — Self-Identity becoming Self-Difference
text.body:
Mono names the singular One; Poly the All through which that One appears: `0 = One = Self-Identity`, `1 = All = Self-Difference`. The whole is structurally prior to its parts. Monoisation names the reversal of office: a local `1` promoted into the `0`-office, presenting itself as the source of its field. Recovery returns each claim to the relations it excluded.
Claim status: Argued.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/mono-poly.md

scenes.name: Complexio Oppositorum — #
scenes.character: The # mark: the whole determining relation, followed through every station.

text.title: Complexio oppositorum
text.italic: the holding of opposites, carried by the # mark
text.body:
The native sign `#` names the whole determining relation followed through every station — different work from any particular `#0` or `#5`. The formless takes form; the form recognises the formless through which it appears. Held polarity `(-1)/(+1)` keeps zero as common axis; cancellation ends the opposition; fusion erases difference. The copula gives the holding its exact form: `/ = ( = =/≠ ≠ )`.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/complexio-oppositorum.md

scenes.name: Self-Identity
scenes.character: The same appears twice, and the relation identifies them.

text.title: Self-Identity
text.italic: identity as an active relation — to, for, as, with
text.body:
To write `A = A` requires two appearances of A and the relation identifying them: sameness is available through difference. Four modalities build: to, for, as, with itself. Two parallel strokes write `=`; crossing them with `/` writes `≠`. The expanded expression holds identity and difference in one readable movement; retaining both opens `(0,0) (0,1) (1,0) (1,1)` — `2 + 2² = 6`.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/self-identity.md

text.title: Subject-Logics
text.italic: the Ø traversal — 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1, returning as 0/1
text.body:
`0` names the unobjectifiable subject-pole. Occlusion `Ø` occurs when the inner instrument — antaḥkaraṇa — is taken as the final knower: computation confused for the computer. `X` marks the field of crossings; `Ø/X` exposes mediation; `(0/Ø)/(1/X)` holds both sides under recognition; `1` affirms the subject's relation to its world, returning as `0/1`. Pramātṛ, pramāṇa, prameya are numerator, slash, denominator.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/subject-logics.md

scenes.name: Eight Determinations — The Complete Traversal
scenes.character: The spine held within the whole: centre threshold, four cardinal stations, thresholds bracketing on the rim.

text.title: Eight Determinations
text.body:
The eight determinations traverse the inner nature of `0/1`: parent relation, sixfold body, return — `(4+2)+2`. Centre: the `0/1` threshold. Cardinals: `?/!` N, `−/+` E, `X/x` S, `AM/IS` W. The ring is the whole, parā: `∞/dx` at the rim, `−/−` entering above, `1/0` returning below. The four heads read this spine; eight plus four: the twelvefold, no thirteenth.
Returns-to: §3 · #0 (Movement 25) and A18.
Source of record: submission-package/essay/symbolon/eight-determinations.md
